package sources

import (
    "context"
    "os"
    "path/filepath"
    "testing"
)

func TestHostedOracleRootfs(t *testing.T) {
    parent := t.TempDir()
    target := filepath.Join(parent, "rootfs")
    source := filepath.Join(target, "rootfs")
    if err := os.MkdirAll(source, 0755); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(target,"installer-only"), []byte("obsolete"), 0600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(source,"payload"), []byte("complete"), 0751); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if err := os.Link(filepath.Join(source,"payload"),filepath.Join(source,"hardlink")); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if err := os.Symlink("payload",filepath.Join(source,"symlink")); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    s := &oraclelinux{}
    s.ctx = context.Background()
    if err := s.stageOracleRootfs(source+"/",target); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    data,err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(target,"payload"))
    if err != nil || string(data)!="complete" { t.Fatalf("incomplete payload: %q %v",data,err) }
    first,err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(target,"payload")); if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    second,err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(target,"hardlink")); if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if first.Mode().Perm()!=0751 || !os.SameFile(first,second) { t.Fatal("mode or hardlink lost") }
    link,err := os.Readlink(filepath.Join(target,"symlink")); if err!=nil || link!="payload" { t.Fatal("symlink lost",err) }
    if _,err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(target,"installer-only")); !os.IsNotExist(err) { t.Fatal("installer tree leaked into image") }
    entries,err := os.ReadDir(parent); if err!=nil || len(entries)!=1 { t.Fatal("staging tree leaked",err) }
}

func TestHostedOracleRootfsCopyFailure(t *testing.T) {
    parent := t.TempDir()
    target := filepath.Join(parent,"rootfs")
    if err := os.MkdirAll(target,0755); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    marker := filepath.Join(target,"original")
    if err := os.WriteFile(marker,[]byte("keep"),0600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    s := &oraclelinux{}
    s.ctx=context.Background()
    if err := s.stageOracleRootfs(filepath.Join(parent,"missing")+"/",target); err==nil { t.Fatal("missing source succeeded") }
    data,err := os.ReadFile(marker); if err!=nil || string(data)!="keep" { t.Fatal("copy failure destroyed original",err) }
    entries,err := os.ReadDir(parent); if err!=nil || len(entries)!=1 { t.Fatal("failed staging tree leaked",err) }
}
